pages.title: Deep resources
pages.text: Typical ore heights:$(li)Negarite and Posirite: Y 6–29.$(li)Lithium: Y 8–19.$(li)Silver: Y 10–19.$(li)Manganese: Y 20–49.$(br2)Veins can extend beyond these heights. Take a stone pickaxe or better, plenty of light, and a safe way out.

pages.title: Higher deposits
pages.text: $(li)Silicon: Y 30–59.$(li)Platinum: Y 30–79.$(li)Lapis and Glowstone: Y 10–29.$(br2)White and blue marble deposits are common from Y 16–69; black marble from Y 10–39.$(br2)Process ores back at your workshop. Save both fuel dusts, even when only one seems scarce.

pages.title: Surface crystals
pages.text: On the barren marble of rough biomes, look for irregular clusters of Negarite or Posirite crystals.$(br2)A stone pickaxe or better yields one matching fuel dust per crystal block. Silk Touch collects the crystal itself. The slightly transparent crystals ring when broken.$(br2)These formations occur in newly explored terrain.
